description: Human GLP-1R from 6X18 chain R. ECD lid 29-127 removed, C-tail 397-423 removed, TM bundle cut at -22 A on the pore axis, floating 128-129 island dropped. 184 residues in four segments: 136-161, 181-246, 267-321, 360-396. 13 extremely exposed membrane-facing hydrophobics charge-swapped to Glu/Lys. Hotspots Arg190, Gln234. Coldspots cover the linker tail 136-139, every exposed membrane-facing hydrophobic, and the 10 surfaces the cut genuinely exposed. Gln213 and Trp214 are excluded: they are solvent-exposed ECL1 residues in the intact receptor (Trp214 at 128 A2 with the lid present) and only gained area because the lid was removed, which is not a cut artefact. forced_targeting OFF - pose_template_binder does that job.
